meta.name: business-health-diagnostic
meta.description: Diagnose SaaS business health across growth, retention, efficiency, and capital. Use when preparing a business review or prioritizing urgent fixes.

copy.tagline: 诊断SaaS业务健康度，聚焦增长、留存与效率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责SaaS产品运营，需要快速定位业务短板
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose SaaS business health across growth, retention, and efficiency
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a SaaS product and need to quickly identify weak spots

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会引导你输入公司阶段、增长、留存、单位经济和资本效率等指标，然后自动生成包含健康评分、维度得分、危险信号和优先建议的综合诊断报告。
howto.when: 当你准备董事会汇报、季度复盘或融资准备，或者直接输入业务指标（如ARR、增长率、NRR等）时触发。

say.text: 帮我诊断一下SaaS业务健康度，我们有$8M ARR，60%年增长。
say.note: 提供关键指标后获得完整诊断。

say.text: 检查我的单位经济模型，看是否健康。
为董事会准备一份健康评分卡。
say.note: 按上下文自动引导指标收集。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude prompts you to input company stage, growth, retention, unit economics, and capital efficiency metrics, then automatically generates a comprehensive diagnostic report with health scores, dimension ratings, red flags, and prioritized recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you are preparing for a board meeting, quarterly review, or fundraising, or when you directly input business metrics like ARR, growth rate, or NRR.

say_en.text: Diagnose our SaaS business health: $8M ARR, 60% YoY growth.
say_en.note: Provides key metrics for complete assessment.

say_en.text: Check my unit economics for health.
Prepare a health scorecard for the board.
